text:
Marcos Diaz: Quick sync — need to hand off mentor pairing + on-call rotation for the next SI cohort. Launch in 3 weeks. Who can own the schedule?
Eleni Park: I can do calendar matching and pair mentors to regions. prefer APAC-friendly slots? :earth_asia:
Riley Chen: I can take the tech-facing pairs (HW + marketplace integration). Will need a 2-hr lab slot for each mentor.
Aisha Patel: I'll run the certification assessments. Thinking a lightweight proctored lab + one practical ticket. ok?
Marcos Diaz: yes. goal: mentors should be able to respond to first-week SI escalations within 30m business hours. We need an on-call roster and an escalation play.
Tom Brooks: can we reuse the existing `si-shadow` rota? it's missing HW specialists though.
Riley Chen: we'll extend it. sample rota snippet:```
Week A: Mentor-A (US), Mentor-B (EMEA)
Week B: Mentor-C (APAC), Mentor-D (US)
On-call window: 9am-6pm local M-F
Escalation: slack #si-escalations -> pager duty -> ENG-SA triage
```
Marcos Diaz: nice. add a 1-hr weekly office hours block where mentors and SI engineers can drop in. keeps onboarding friction down.
Eleni Park: I'll publish invites and tag mentors. Also want to link the HW validation checklist in the invite: https://redwood.internal/si/hw-checklist (internal).
Aisha Patel: For certification: propose two tiers — Foundations (1.5h test + lab) and Integrator (3h hands-on + ticket). Badge generated via LMS upon pass.
Tom Brooks: question: do we require marketplace listing knowledge? many SI partners will need to onboard to `cloud-marketplace` flows.
Riley Chen: yes — include a 30-min module on marketplace packaging and two sample PRs. Prep needed: `workspace-aws-marketplace` creds + marketplace sandbox.
Marcos Diaz: deliverables for next Monday: 1) mentor roster + timezone map 2) office-hours schedule 3) cert rubric + pass criteria 4) brief on escalation play (who calls ENG-SA)
Eleni Park: acknowledged. I'll have calendar + invites by Mon EOD.
Aisha Patel: I'll drop the cert rubric doc in the cohort folder and send a short quiz link.
Tom Brooks: I'll coordinate marketplace sandbox creds with infra. FYI we'll likely need a quick legal checklist for listing — looping in partnerships legal separately.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Create cohort workspace `si-cohort-2026-03` and seed with trainers, mentors, and SI test accounts. (automated)
Marcos Diaz: thanks all. last ask — keep the first week mentor:mentee ratio at 1:6 max. helps with handoffs. :thumbsup:
Riley Chen: noted. will prep lab images and a one-pager for mentor quick reference (`mentor-quickref.md`).
Eleni Park: tagging @Aisha and @Riley in invites once done.
Aisha Patel: cool — will run a dry-run of the proctored lab next Wed 10:30 PT, anyone welcome to join.
Tom Brooks: can join.
Marcos Diaz: wrap — if anyone hits blockers, post in #partnerships or ping me directly.
Eleni Park: thanks — will post the roster when ready. :rocket:
